name: Isomalt
aliases: E953, isomalt, hydrogenated isomaltulose, isomaltitol, Palatinit, isomaltulose hydrogenation products
what_is: A mixture of polyols produced by hydrogenating isomaltulose and used as a bulk sweetener and texturising ingredient.
why_botia: BOTIA flags it because E953 provides sweetness and bulk while also affecting product texture, and its authorised uses depend on local food-additive rules.
can_1: Identify E953, isomalt or hydrogenated isomaltulose when declared on the label.
can_2: Trigger the E-number, sweetener and texture information layers.
cannot_1: Determine the amount present from the ingredient list alone.
cannot_2: Predict an individual's digestive response or the product's overall metabolic effect from this ingredient alone.

sources.label: FDA — Aspartame and Other Sweeteners in Food
EU specifications for authorised food additives — Regulation (EU) No 231/2012
